## How to apply

| | |
|---|---|
| **Process** | self serve form |

**[Apply →](https://discover.vultr.com/startup-program)**

### What they ask of you in return

- Share your last 6 months of cloud compute invoices
- Agree to be publicly referenceable as a member of the Vultr Digital Start-up Program
- Provide the name and contact details of your senior-most technical executive, such as your CTO or equivalent
- Submit the name and contact details of your senior-most technical cloud infrastructure leader
